title: Debates Over the Future Architecture of the European Union
grammar: Hedging and polite disagreement (fenntartásait fejezné ki, aggályosnak találná)
goal: I can evaluate contrasting visions of European integration: federalism vs. a 'Europe of Nations' (nemzetek Európája).
I can use diplomatic hedging to voice reservations, polite objections, and dissenting legal stances in Hungarian.
I can discuss unanimity vs. qualified majority voting in foreign policy and immigration quota disputes.
